thesis: Christian Rudder describes his career trajectory from creating a failed stockbroker reporting tool in 1998 to joining Spark.com as a comedy writer, where he helped launch the viral content platform that eventually led to the success of SparkNotes. He explains that he founded OKCupid in 2003, initially focusing on the band Bishop Allen before shifting full-time to the dating site, where he used data analysis and a blog to attract users through interesting content about race, sex, and attraction.
